//: Three notes, in the single key turbo accepts as a comment. agentGuidance=false: CLAUDE.md is the single source of agent instructions in this repo, so turbo must not maintain an AGENTS.md block. test:integration is never cached: it passes or fails on a Postgres container, the Docker daemon is not part of the hash, and a cached pass would claim a database came up that never did. And githubActionsRemoteBaseRefFallback: the CI runs every task with --affected, which compares the branch against main, but actions/checkout leaves a detached HEAD where main exists only as origin/main; without this flag turbo cannot resolve the base ref and falls back to treating every package as changed.
